Access.description:
How the caller will use the model. Added in 2.6.

``chat_app``: a provider's chat app, through a subscription plan.
``coding_tool``: a coding harness, through a plan or pay-per-use;
``harness`` names one from ``registry/harnesses.yaml`` (any when absent).
``own_software``: the caller's own software, pay-per-use (or a plan whose
surfaces include ``api``). ``own_hardware``: self-hosted on the caller's
devices. A spec may give the bare kind as a string.
Access.title: Access

BandEntry.description: One model in a band, through its best offering. Added in 2.7 (MODEL-206).
BandEntry.title: BandEntry

Bands.description:
The ranked models in three bands (MODEL-206). Added in 2.7.

``best`` is the leader and every model with enough evidence whose score is
at least the leader's with probability ``band_probability`` or more,
ordered by ``p_best``. ``rest`` holds the other models with enough
evidence and ``thin`` the models with a weighted capability interval wider
than ``thin_interval_width``, both in score order. Every ranked model is in
exactly one band.
Bands.title: Bands

BenchmarkEstimateChange.description: How one model's domain estimate changed after removing evidence. Added in 1.12.
BenchmarkEstimateChange.title: BenchmarkEstimateChange

BenchmarkExclusions.description: Benchmarks a spec distrusted and their visible estimate effects. Added in 1.12.
BenchmarkExclusions.title: BenchmarkExclusions

BlendTerm.description:
One weighted dimension, its share, and the order on it alone. Added in 2.7 (MODEL-206).

The weighted score mixes these dimensions; each term says who leads on
that dimension by itself. A capability term leads with the best point
estimate among models with enough evidence on it; ``thin`` lists the rest.
An exact term (cost, a fact, a preference) can have several ``leaders``
when they share the best value.
BlendTerm.title: BlendTerm

CitedSource.description: One registered source, listed once per decision. Added in 1.4.
CitedSource.title: CitedSource

Compare.description: ``facet op value``; the value may be ``model(<id>)`` for a relative condition.
Compare.title: Compare

Decision.description: The engine's answer to one spec against one snapshot.
Decision.title: Decision

DimensionEstimate.description: A band entry's estimate on one weighted capability. Added in 2.7 (MODEL-206).
DimensionEstimate.title: DimensionEstimate

Estate.description:
What the caller holds, sent with the spec and never stored. Added in 2.3.

``providers`` are provider IDs the caller has a key for, ``plans`` are
subscription plan IDs, ``devices`` are hardware SKU IDs. ``exhausted`` lists
providers or plans that cannot be used right now; an exhausted provider
takes its key and its plans with it.
Estate.title: Estate

EstateGap.description: Why the two answers differ, or that they do not.
EstateGap.title: EstateGap

EstateMark.description: How the estate reaches one row, and what one more task costs the caller.
EstateMark.title: EstateMark

EvidenceQualifiers.description: Which evidence may satisfy a condition on an evidence facet.
EvidenceQualifiers.title: EvidenceQualifiers

FeedbackPointer.description:
Where to say whether this answer held up. The same on every decision.

Added in 2.10 (MODEL-221), so that an agent holding an answer finds the
feedback endpoint without reading anything else. No key is needed.
FeedbackPointer.title: FeedbackPointer

GainItem.description: One hold the caller does not have whose addition would change the answer.
GainItem.title: GainItem

InSet.description: ``facet in {a, b}`` or ``facet not in {a, b}``. Values are kept sorted and unique.
InSet.title: InSet

Known.description: ``known(facet)``: passes when the facet is known. It is never unknown itself.
Known.title: Known

ModelEliminationGroup.description: One eliminated model, with its model row or offering rows. Added in 1.6.
ModelEliminationGroup.title: ModelEliminationGroup

ModelOffering.description: One offering of a model in ``by_model``, with why it is or is not ranked. Added in 2.5.
ModelOffering.title: ModelOffering

ModelRef.description: The right-hand side of a relative condition: ``coding >= model(openai/gpt-6-sol)``.
ModelRef.title: ModelRef

ModelRow.description:
One model, with all its offerings, in ranking order. Added in 2.5.

A model is ``ranked`` when any offering is, else ``may_qualify`` when any
is unknown on a facet, else ``eliminated``. ``rank`` is ``Result.model_rank``.
Eliminated models appear only when the explanation carries eliminations.
ModelRow.title: ModelRow

OfferingElimination.description: Why one offering of an eliminated model left the lineup. Added in 1.6.
OfferingElimination.title: OfferingElimination

PlanAllowance.description: A plan's published usage allowance; each part is null unless published. Added in 2.6.
PlanAllowance.title: PlanAllowance

PlanCoverage.description:
Why a plan counts as covering a model. Added in 2.6.

``family`` and ``quote`` are the family the plan page names and the page's
own words; both are absent when the plan's ``models_covered`` names the
model directly. ``resolves_to`` is every model the entry reaches, by
``rule``.
PlanCoverage.title: PlanCoverage

PlanPrice.description: A plan's published list price for one billing period. Added in 2.6.
PlanPrice.title: PlanPrice

PlanRoute.description:
A subscription plan that reaches a result on the spec's ``access``. Added in 2.6.

``break_even_tasks_per_month`` is the plan's monthly price divided by this
result's pay-per-use cost per task, for ``access: coding_tool`` only, and
null when either is unknown. ``basis`` says how it was computed or why not.
ModelSpec never turns a plan price into a per-task cost.
PlanRoute.title: PlanRoute

Preference.description: A weighted preference for one value of a boolean or enum facet.
Preference.title: Preference

RefinementEstimate.description:
A refinement estimate nested in its parent domain. Added in 2.4 (MODEL-190).

``evidence_count`` 0 means no refinement evidence: the value is the
parent's estimate and the interval is wider by the refinement's spread.
RefinementEstimate.title: RefinementEstimate

RefinementGain.description: ``gain`` for one refinement dimension. Added in 2.4 (MODEL-190).
RefinementGain.title: RefinementGain

Relaxation.description:
The smallest change to one numeric cap or floor that admits a model. Added in 1.5.

``condition`` is the spec's condition; ``relaxed`` is the same facet and
direction at ``value``, in ``unit``, the nearest value any excluded
candidate has; ``admits`` counts the models that then qualify.
Relaxation.title: Relaxation

Soft.description: A soft condition: violating it costs ``penalty`` of the objective instead of eliminating.
Soft.title: Soft

TaskTokens.description: How many tokens one task takes. ``offering.cost_per_task`` is priced from it.
TaskTokens.title: TaskTokens

Tolerance.description: How far below the best a lexicographic step may be and still tie: ``5%`` or a number.
Tolerance.title: Tolerance

Truncated.description: Qualifying rows omitted only because of the requested result limit. Added in 1.9.
Truncated.title: Truncated

WithEstate.description: The same question answered from what the caller holds. Added in 2.3.
WithEstate.title: WithEstate
